an7.68:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.68:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaparovaraññū ca. (1)
an7.68:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an7.68:2.4: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:2.5: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ nayidha dhammaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:2.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhammaṃ jānāti
an7.68:2.7: suttaṃ geyyaṃ …pe… abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, tasmā bhikkhu dhammaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:3.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti
an7.68:3.3: “ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho”ti.
an7.68:3.4: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhu tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:3.5: “ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃimassa bhāsitassa atthoti” nayidha atthaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:3.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhū tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti
an7.68:3.7: “ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho”ti. tasmā atthaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:4.3: ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenāti.
an7.68:4.4: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhu attānaṃ jāneyya
an7.68:4.5: ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenāti, nayidha attaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:4.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu attānaṃ jānāti
an7.68:4.7: ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenāti. tasmā attaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:5.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jānāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya.
an7.68:5.3: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jāneyya cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya, nayidha mattaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:5.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jānāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya, tasmā mattaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:6.3: ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyāti.
an7.68:6.4: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhū kālaṃ jāneyya,
an7.68:6.5: ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyāti nayidha kālaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:6.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālaṃ jānāti:
an7.68:6.7: ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānāyā’ti tasmā kālaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:6.8: iti dhammaññū atthaññū attaññū mattaññū kālaññū. (6)
an7.68:7.3: ayaṃ khattiya parisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇa parisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā,
an7.68:7.4: tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ kattabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhībhavitabbanti.
an7.68:7.5: no ce bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisaṃ jāneyya:
an7.68:7.6: ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapati parisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā, tattha
an7.68:7.7: evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ kattabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhībhavitabbanti. nayidha parisaññūti vucceyya.
an7.68:7.8: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisaṃ jānāti:
an7.68:7.9: ayaṃ khattiya parisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā,
an7.68:7.10: tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ kattabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhībhavitabbanti. tasmā parisaññūti vuccati.
an7.68:7.11: iti dhammaññū atthaññū attaññū mattaññū kālaññū parisaññū.
an7.68:8.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dvayena puggalā viditā honti.
an7.68:8.4: eko ariyānaṃ dassanakāmo, eko ariyānaṃ na dassanakāmo.
an7.68:9.2: eko saddhammaṃ sotukāmo, eko saddhammaṃ na sotukāmo.
an7.68:10.2: eko ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, eko anohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an7.68:11.2: eko sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, eko sutvā dhammaṃ na dhāreti.
an7.68:11.3: yvāyaṃ puggalo sutvā dhammaṃ na dhāreti,
an7.68:12.2: eko dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati, eko dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati.
an7.68:12.3: yvāyaṃ puggalo dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati,
an7.68:12.5: yvāyaṃ puggalo dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati,
an7.68:13.1: dve puggalā dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti:
an7.68:13.2: eko atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno, eko na atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno.
an7.68:13.3: yvāyaṃ puggalo na atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno,
an7.68:14.2: eko attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya. eko attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca.
an7.68:14.3: yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
an7.68:14.5: yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca,
an7.68:15.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dvayena puggalā viditā honti.
an7.68:16.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu puggalaparovaraññū hoti.
an7.68:16.2: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
